full_text:
SHIMLA: An
earthquake of magnitude 4.1 struck Shimla in Himachal Pradesh at 4.36 am on Saturday, according to the National Centre for Seismology (NCS).
The earthquake occurred at a depth of 10 km, the NCS said. The
tremor was recorded at 4:36:27 am Indian Standard Time (IST).
The epicentre was located 40 km east-northeast (ENE) of Shimla, according to the NCS.
